-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

list-notebooks.name: list-notebooks
list-notebooks.description: List every OneNote notebook the signed-in account can open, including shared ones.

get-notebook.name: get-notebook
get-notebook.description: Get one OneNote notebook by id, with its name, sharing state, and web URL.

params.notebookId: Notebook id, as returned by list-notebooks.

create-notebook.name: create-notebook
create-notebook.description: Create a new OneNote notebook. Names may not contain ? * \ / : < > | ' " # and are limited to 50 characters.

params.displayName: Notebook name. Max 50 characters; ? * \ / : < > | ' " # are not allowed.

list-sections.name: list-sections
list-sections.description: List OneNote sections. Scoped to one notebook when notebookId is given, this returns only that notebook's top-level sections — sections nested inside a section group are not included. Omit notebookId to list every section the account can reach, section groups included.

params.notebookId: Optional notebook id from list-notebooks. Returns only that notebook's top-level sections — sections inside a section group are not included. Omit to list sections across all notebooks, including ones inside section groups.

create-section.name: create-section
create-section.description: Create a section inside a OneNote notebook. Names may not contain ? * \ / : < > | ' " # and are limited to 50 characters.

params.parentNotebookId: Id of the notebook to create the section in, from list-notebooks. Also accepted as notebookId.
params.displayName: Section name. Max 50 characters; ? * \ / : < > | ' " # are not allowed.

list-section-groups.name: list-section-groups
list-section-groups.description: List OneNote section groups — the folders that hold sections inside a notebook. Scoped to one notebook when notebookId is given.

params.notebookId: Optional notebook id from list-notebooks. Omit to list section groups across all notebooks.

list-pages.name: list-pages
list-pages.description: List OneNote pages, newest first. Scoped to one section when sectionId is given, otherwise across every notebook. Returns metadata only — use get-page-content to read a page.

params.sectionId: Optional section id from list-sections. Omit to list recent pages across all notebooks.
params.top: Maximum pages to return. Defaults to 50, capped at 100.

get-page.name: get-page
get-page.description: Get one OneNote page by id: its title, timestamps, position, and parent section. Use get-page-content to read the page body.

params.pageId: Page id, as returned by list-pages or search-pages.

get-page-content.name: get-page-content
get-page-content.description: Read the body of a OneNote page. Returns markdown by default. Set includeIDs to get the element ids that append-to-page and replace-page-content can target — that always returns HTML, because markdown cannot carry the ids.

params.pageId: Page id, as returned by list-pages or search-pages.
params.format: Output format. Defaults to markdown. Forced to html when includeIDs is set.
params.includeIDs: Include OneNote data-id attributes so individual elements can be targeted for editing. Implies format: html.

create-page.name: create-page
create-page.description: Create a OneNote page in a section. Content is markdown by default and is converted to the HTML OneNote stores.

params.parentSectionId: Id of the section to create the page in, from list-sections. Also accepted as sectionId.
params.title: Page title. OneNote stores this as the page's <title> element — there is no separate title field.
params.content: Page body, in markdown unless contentFormat says otherwise.
params.contentFormat: Format of `content`. Defaults to markdown. Use html to pass OneNote markup through unchanged.

delete-page.name: delete-page
delete-page.description: Delete a OneNote page. The page goes to the notebook recycle bin, but this cannot be undone from here.

params.pageId: Page id, as returned by list-pages or search-pages.

copy-page-to-section.name: copy-page-to-section
copy-page-to-section.description: Copy a OneNote page into another section, including across notebooks. Waits for the copy to finish and returns the new page id.

params.pageId: Id of the page to copy, from list-pages or search-pages.
params.destinationSectionId: Id of the section to copy the page into, from list-sections.

append-to-page.name: append-to-page
append-to-page.description: Add content to an existing OneNote page without removing anything. Appends to the end of the page by default; pass a target element id from get-page-content (includeIDs: true) to add next to a specific element.

params.pageId: Page id, as returned by list-pages or search-pages.
params.content: Content to add, in markdown unless contentFormat says otherwise.
params.target: Where to add the content: "body" (default), or a data-id from get-page-content with includeIDs: true.
params.position: Whether the content goes after (default) or before the target.

replace-page-content.name: replace-page-content
replace-page-content.description: Replace the content of a OneNote page, or just its title. This overwrites what was there and cannot be undone — use append-to-page to add without removing.

params.pageId: Page id, as returned by list-pages or search-pages.
params.content: Replacement content, in markdown unless contentFormat says otherwise. When target is "title", this is plain text.
params.contentFormat: Format of `content`. Defaults to markdown. Ignored when target is "title".
params.target: What to replace: "body" (default), "title", or a data-id from get-page-content with includeIDs: true.

search-pages.name: search-pages
search-pages.description: Search OneNote pages by text. Results may not be exhaustive — OneNote search coverage varies by account type, and this falls back to matching page titles when full-text search is unavailable. Use list-pages to browse a section reliably.

params.query: Text to search for. Pass the literal text, not a pre-encoded string.
params.top: Maximum pages to return. Defaults to 25, capped at 100.

name: OneNote
description: Microsoft OneNote automation — browse notebooks and sections, read and write pages as markdown, and search notes via the Microsoft Graph OneNote API

changelog.notes: Initial release — read, write, and search OneNote notebooks, sections, and pages
